ground_truth_affected_note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION WARNING, this row is a strong adversarial case. All eleven hop1 candidates for 'bp' are crude and refined-product customers (CPC Taiwan, Formosa Petrochemical, Indian Oil, Jordan Petroleum Refinery, LG Chem, POSCO, Ternium, Volkswagen and so on), and none of them experienced a supply disruption: Macondo was a single exploration well, not a producing asset, and BP's crude and product supply to customers was not interrupted. On that last point: the 30 May 2010 deepwater drilling moratorium hit rival offshore drillers such as Diamond Offshore and Hercules Offshore through contract cancellations, which is a regulatory-contagion channel rather than a supply-chain one. I have not listed those because I did not source individual cancellations within this batch, but they are the richest remaining vein if you want more names. Scoring hop1 hits as true positives on this event would be wrong in every case.
